headline: Failed Senate resolution would have blocked a proposed U.S. sale of certain military equipment and services to Israel.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have stopped a specific proposed foreign military sale of certain defense items and services from the United States to the government of Israel. Congress can use this kind of resolution to reject an arms sale the executive branch has formally proposed. The official summary does not list the exact weapons or services involved. The Senate voted not to take it up on July 30, 2025, so the sale was not blocked by this measure.

who_it_affects.how: Israel would not have received the specific defense items and services covered by the proposed sale.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. defense companies supplying the sale
who_it_affects.how: Companies set to provide the equipment or services would have lost this particular sale.
